summary.en: Florentine poet, philosopher and politician. A White Guelph, he was exiled from Florence in 1302 and never returned; he wrote the Commedia in exile and died in Ravenna. Besides the poem he wrote the Vita Nuova and treatises on language, philosophy and empire.

en: Served as one of Florence's six priors in 1300
Also wrote the Vita Nuova, Convivio, De vulgari eloquentia and Monarchia
